column1: # The environment of the stand processes: the variables a stand process receives (stand.md «Environment of stand processes»).
# A row admits a variable to the environment of a stand process; other variables of the environment of the runner are not inherited. A listed name is
# admitted, not required. stand.md refers to this form and does not repeat its names and values.
# name: the variable, by ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$; once in the form.
# value: the value the stand gives every process that receives the variable, on the stand of one server and without the words of a directive. A value
# in braces is a substitution of «Stand» of the instance ({data}, {port}, {rport}, {manifest}); a part in angle brackets is named by norm. - — the form
# sets no value: the runner, a directive, a lesson README or a topic of the common acceptance sets it, as norm names. The words of a directive (on <server>,
# <NAME>=<value> of @start and the others of the dictionary) give their own value instead.
# processes: every — every stand process; process-stands — the processes of the stands of processes and chapters (stand.md «Layout by processes (stage C)»,
# Besides the rows, stand.md admits the variable named by slot.name_env of a stand manifest and the names of one launch (the assignments of @start,
# W2C_TOKEN of the person's command of @move).
# norm: the norms of the subject and the place of the common acceptance that sets or varies the value.
